statements: ALTER TABLE cla_native_v2_publication_attempts ADD COLUMN send_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(send_until>=0)

CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_agreement_activations (
 generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(generation>0),hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 activation_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(activation_revision>0),repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(repository_id>0),
 holder_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(holder_id>0),reference_sha TEXT NOT NULL,policy_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 individual_version TEXT NOT NULL,individual_digest TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_agreement_documents(digest),
 corporate_version TEXT NOT NULL,corporate_digest TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_agreement_documents(digest),
 observation_json TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created>=0)
)

CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_delegated_controls (
 grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_delegated_grants(id),sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
 body TEXT NOT NULL,signature TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('enable','suspend','revoke')),issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(grant_id,sequence)
)
CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_delegated_grants (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body TEXT NOT NULL,signature TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,public_key TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_delegated_receipts (
 packet TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_packets(id),grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_delegated_grants(id),control_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_delegated_controls(hash),
 contributor_hash TEXT NOT NULL,cipher TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(packet,grant_id,control_hash)
)
CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_head_deliveries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,request_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_head_requests(request_key),created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_head_requests (
 request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,pr INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pr>0),head TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','done','dispatched','manual')),attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE cla_native_v2_slot_policy (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),protocol TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(protocol='cla-confirmation-slot-v1'),
 first_attempt TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cla_native_v2_publication_attempts(id),
 active_attempt TEXT REFERENCES cla_native_v2_publication_attempts(id),created INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_activation_order BEFORE INSERT ON cla_native_v2_agreement_activations BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.generation!=coalesce((SELECT max(generation) FROM cla_native_v2_agreement_activations),0)+1
 OR NEW.previous_hash!=coalesce((SELECT hash FROM cla_native_v2_agreement_activations ORDER BY generation DESC LIMIT 1),printf('%064d',0))
 OR NEW.activation_revision!=(SELECT revision FROM cla_native_v2_state WHERE id=1)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'cla_native_v2_activation_order') END;
END
CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_activations_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cla_native_v2_agreement_activations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_activations_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_agreement_activations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_delegated_control_order BEFORE INSERT ON cla_native_v2_delegated_controls BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.sequence!=coalesce((SELECT max(sequence) FROM cla_native_v2_delegated_controls WHERE grant_id=NEW.grant_id),0)+1
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_delegated_controls WHERE grant_id=NEW.grant_id AND action='revoke')
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'control_order') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_delegated_controls_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_delegated_controls BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_head_request_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_head_requests WHEN NEW.request_key!=OLD.request_key OR NEW.pr!=OLD.pr OR NEW.head!=OLD.head OR NEW.created!=OLD.created
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_identity'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_outbox_slot_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cla_native_v2_outbox WHEN EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p WHERE p.target_key=OLD.target_key AND p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'slot_recovery_required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_publication_slot_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cla_native_v2_publication_attempts WHEN
 OLD.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) OR
 CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.observation) THEN json_extract(OLD.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1'
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'slot_history_protected'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_publication_slot_insert BEFORE INSERT ON cla_native_v2_publication_attempts BEGIN
 -- REPLACE may skip DELETE triggers. Fence it before any implicit delete.
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p WHERE p.id=NEW.id AND (
   p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) OR
   CASE WHEN json_valid(p.observation) THEN json_extract(p.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2__guards WHERE id='confirmation-slot:'||NEW.id)))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p WHERE p.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1)
  AND p.target_key=NEW.target_key AND (p.head_sha=NEW.head_sha OR p.phase IN ('issued','unknown')))
 OR CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.observation) THEN json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1'
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_history_protected') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.conclusion='success' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2__guards WHERE id='confirmation-slot:'||NEW.id AND ok=1)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_required') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2__guards WHERE id='confirmation-slot:'||NEW.id) AND coalesce((
  NEW.conclusion='success' AND NEW.phase='issued' AND NEW.send_until>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE active_attempt IS NOT NULL)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts WHERE conclusion='success' AND phase!='resolved')
 ),0)!=1 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_capacity_unavailable') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_publication_slot_release AFTER UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_publication_attempts
 WHEN OLD.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND NEW.phase='resolved' BEGIN
 UPDATE cla_native_v2_slot_policy SET active_attempt=NULL WHERE id=1 AND active_attempt=NEW.id;
END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_publication_slot_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_publication_attempts BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN (OLD.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) OR
  CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.observation) THEN json_extract(OLD.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1') AND
  (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.target_key IS NOT OLD.target_key OR NEW.head_sha IS NOT OLD.head_sha OR NEW.revision IS NOT OLD.revision
   OR NEW.expires IS NOT OLD.expires OR NEW.conclusion IS NOT OLD.conclusion OR NEW.proof_text IS NOT OLD.proof_text OR NEW.created IS NOT OLD.created
   OR (OLD.run_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.run_id IS NOT OLD.run_id)) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_identity_immutable') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.observation) THEN json_extract(OLD.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1'
  AND NEW.observation IS NOT OLD.observation THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_release_immutable') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND NEW.send_until IS NOT OLD.send_until
  AND NOT(OLD.phase='issued' AND NEW.phase IN ('unknown','reconcile') AND NEW.send_until=0)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_send_fence_protected') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.id=(SELECT active_attempt FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy WHERE id=1) AND NEW.phase='resolved' AND coalesce((
  OLD.send_until<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) AND CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.observation) THEN
   json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.protocol')='cla-negative-release-v1'
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.attempt')=OLD.id AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.target_key')=OLD.target_key
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.head')=OLD.head_sha AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.original_revision')=OLD.revision
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.proof_text')=OLD.proof_text AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.expires')=OLD.expires
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.old_run_id') IS OLD.run_id AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.observed_phase')=OLD.phase
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.run_id')=NEW.run_id AND NEW.run_id>0
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.source') IN ('observed_get','withdrawal_get')
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.observed_at')<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.valid_until')>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
   AND json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.recovery_revision')=(SELECT revision FROM cla_native_v2_state WHERE id=1)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_outbox o WHERE o.target_key=OLD.target_key AND o.lease=json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.lease')
    AND o.generation=json_extract(NEW.observation,'$.generation') AND o.lease_until>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)) END
 ),0)!=1 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'fresh_negative_release_required') END;
END
CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_slot_policy_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cla_native_v2_slot_policy BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'slot_policy_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_slot_policy_insert BEFORE INSERT ON cla_native_v2_slot_policy BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_slot_policy) OR coalesce((NEW.active_attempt=NEW.first_attempt
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p JOIN cla_native_v2__guards g ON g.id='confirmation-slot:'||p.id AND g.ok=1
   WHERE p.id=NEW.active_attempt AND p.phase='issued' AND p.conclusion='success' AND p.send_until>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER))),0)!=1
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_policy_enrollment_required') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER cla_native_v2_slot_policy_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cla_native_v2_slot_policy BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.protocol IS NOT OLD.protocol OR NEW.first_attempt IS NOT OLD.first_attempt
  OR NEW.created IS NOT OLD.created THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_policy_immutable') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce((
  (OLD.active_attempt IS NULL AND NEW.active_attempt IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p JOIN cla_native_v2__guards g ON g.id='confirmation-slot:'||p.id AND g.ok=1
    WHERE p.id=NEW.active_attempt AND p.phase='issued' AND p.conclusion='success' AND p.send_until>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)))
  OR (OLD.active_attempt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.active_attempt IS NULL AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM cla_native_v2_publication_attempts p JOIN cla_native_v2_outbox o ON o.target_key=p.target_key WHERE p.id=OLD.active_attempt AND p.phase='resolved'
    AND CASE WHEN json_valid(p.observation) THEN json_extract(p.observation,'$.protocol') END='cla-negative-release-v1'
    AND json_extract(p.observation,'$.attempt')=p.id AND json_extract(p.observation,'$.run_id')=p.run_id
    AND json_extract(p.observation,'$.recovery_revision')=(SELECT revision FROM cla_native_v2_state WHERE id=1)
    AND json_extract(p.observation,'$.observed_at')<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
    AND json_extract(p.observation,'$.valid_until')>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
    AND o.lease=json_extract(p.observation,'$.lease') AND o.generation=json_extract(p.observation,'$.generation')
    AND o.lease_until>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)))
 ),0)!=1 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'slot_transition_rejected') END;
END
